title: hesperis meyeri
intro: Hesperis meyeri, commonly known as the sweet rocket or Dame's rocket, is a flowering plant native to the Caucasus region and parts of Europe. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, thanks to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hesperis meyeri include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
